sentences.text: Heard on I.A. No.1175/2026, which is the an application under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C./Section 430(1) of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to appellant Harshit Gayakwad.

The appellant is aggrieved of the judgment dated 17.12.2025 passed by the learned Special Judge (POCSO Act), Betul in S.C. No.51/2020, whereby the learned trial Court has convicted and sentenced the appellant as under :-
 Conviction Senten  
 Section Act Imprisonment Fine  
 5(l)/6  included POCSO Act  R.I. for 20 years Rs.5000/- 
 Section & IPC  376(2)(n)
It is submitted that age of the victim is doubtful.
Victim (PW-5) has herself admitted that her date of birth is not that of 2007, but her birth had taken place on 11.05.2000.
It is pointed out that prosecution has not produced the first school entry register.
They have only produced the register through which appellant had taken admission in third class.
There is no matriculation certificate or birth certificate.
As per ossification report (Ex.P-29), age of the victim was opined to be 17 years approximately by Dr. O.P. Yadav (PW-6).
Therefore, when margin of 1 year plus minus is taken into consideration, then victim may would have been a 2 CRA-561-2026 major at the time of incident.
It is further submitted that there are good chances of success in the appeal.
Hence, prayer is made to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the appellant and to release him on bail.

sentences.text: Ms. Shweta Yadav, learned Deputy Advocate General for the State, in his turn, opposes the prayer for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the record so also looking to the fact that the appeal is going to take time for its disposal, without commenting on the merits of the case,
we are of the considered opinion that this is a fit case to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the appellant and to release him on bail. I.A.No.1175/2026 is accordingly allowed.

It is directed that on depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing a personal bond to the tune of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with two solvent sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the trial Court on 27.05.2026 and on such other dates as may be fixed by the trial Court, the execution of remaining part of the jail sentence imposed upon appellant shall remain suspended and he shall be released on bail till final disposal of this appeal.
List the case for final hearing in Part-B of the cause list as per its turn and seniority.
